messages.text: Morning all. Quarterly access recert campaign opened yesterday for Technology. Please clear your assigned reviews by EOD Tuesday. PositionStore and DataLake entitlements are the big ones this round.
Are we reviewing direct reports only, or also the service accounts we own? I've got 3 service accounts showing up in my queue.
Both. Service accounts need an owner attestation plus a justification note. If nobody can say why it exists, flag it for revocation.
Heads up, DataLake has about 40 read-write grants on the raw zone that look stale. Several people have moved teams since the last cycle. I'm going to mark those for downgrade to read-only.
+1 on that. Just make sure the nightly ETL role isn't caught in the sweep. It needs write on raw or the loads will fail.
Good call, I'll exclude the ETL role and list it as approved with a note. Thanks Leo.
Question on PositionStore: the break-glass admin group still has 9 members. Last audit said keep it under 5. Who actually needs standing access?
Agree it's too many. Proposal: SRE on-call plus Leo as backup, everyone else moves to just-in-time elevation through the ticket flow. I'll draft the change.
I'm in that group from the migration last year and don't need it anymore. Feel free to pull me out.
Works for me. Please keep the JIT approval SLA tight though, 15 minutes max, otherwise we'll be stuck during an incident.
Done with my service accounts. Revoked one that was orphaned from a decommissioned batch job and attested the other two.
Nice progress everyone. Current completion is about 60%. I'll post the remaining list tomorrow and send the evidence export to Compliance once we hit 100%.
